titleText: JTF News: The Guardian, Deutsche Welle
mainText: Fujimori declared winner of presidential election in Peru.

titleText: JTF News: UN News, The Guardian
mainText: An earthquake and aftershock occurred near Venezuela's capital city; a man was rescued from rubble after being trapped for 106 hours.
President Trump stated Iran has requested a meeting with the U.S., while Iranian officials stated no meeting has been scheduled.

titleText: JTF News: PBS NewsHour, BBC News
mainText: Five people were shot dead at a youth welfare centre in northern Germany.
A earthquake in Venezuela resulted in 1,719 deaths and more than 5,000 injuries.
